provenanceContract.sourceMetadataResolution: Each external overlap resolves repository, exact reviewed revision, licence and runtime-dependency status by sourceId through docs/method-sources.json.
provenanceContract.candidateImplementationRule: An adapt-local or vendor-slice entry remains candidate until a focused implementation records exact provenance and modifications and protects the retained benefit with evidence or tests; shipped local methods are marked adopted.
provenanceContract.observationRule: Observe and reject entries are not runtime dependencies and do not authorize copying upstream material.
